provenance.projection: hack/e5/e5.py publish_campaign request whitelist; one stage only
limitations: Recorded-input projection sample, not a deployed publication. Request identity fields absent from the original publish whitelist remain absent. Energy coverage/bound copied from the retained #213 tables.txt JSON, not recalculated.
Large issuanceFidelity.gapIntervalsOver50MS diagnostic intervals omitted from this fixture; all scalar publication metrics retained.

image-classification-tight-slo.latencyScope: Gateway elapsedNanos: CHILL receipt to response, per 03_routing; scheduled/client round trip are reference only
image-classification-tight-slo.entranceDelayMeaning: receivedAt minus client sentAtUnixNS; cross-host clock uncertainty retained, not clamped or interpreted as pure network delay

issuanceFidelity.meaning: Offered is the full frozen trace, including unsent arrivals; supplied requires every planned arrival issued, not merely an unchanged actual-count denominator. Late sends, including sends after the window, remain visible. Per-producer monotonic infer-call timestamps, sorted across workers; gaps run through the later of window end and last send. Planned Poisson/zero-load gaps are not automatically stalls. No wall-clock or gateway causality claim.

image-classification-tight-slo.population: Frozen offered arrivals; final outcome and successful execution populations remain separate
